why.finalAttempt: {{n}} unanswered attempts against a {{tier}} score. One last try in two days, then park as Cold rather than keep spending calls.
why.messageOnSource: Three misses by phone. This lead arrived on {{source}}, so a written message is more likely to get a reply than a fourth ring.
why.retryDifferentTime: Both attempts landed in the same window. Shifting a few hours is the cheapest way to convert a no-answer.
why.callbackAgreed: The student named the time. A missed callback is the most common reason a warm lead goes quiet — honour it exactly.
why.confirmAttendance: The consultation is on the calendar. A same-day confirmation call cuts no-shows sharply.
why.gapsMany: {{n}} qualification fields are still empty. No plan can be quoted, and the contract cannot be raised, until they are on record.
why.gapsOne: Only one field is missing. Close that gap and this lead is contract-ready.
why.closeNow: Fully qualified, {{tier}} score, and the {{intake}} intake closes soon. Move to contract today rather than scheduling another touch.
why.keepMomentum: Qualified but the intake is far out. Keep momentum with materials, then book the consultation.
